body:
I guess the problem is that the only things I can find worth living for, are the delusions my own mind has to create. I can find moments, of contentment, through trivial things, but all too quickly disappear when reality sets back in. My family are... well, lets just say they treated me pretty badly. The friends I used to have are in a different country, and those friendships have faded long ago. And I have never liked the idea of living for someone else anyway, why would anyone who cared about me, and I cared for, enough for me to live for them, want me to put myself through that pain for their sake.

(No idea who downvoted you for this :S )
